text:
oncall-bot: Pager triggered: service=redwood-api severity=pg. Symptom: elevated p99 latency for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Auto-escalation to primary oncall.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0412-7. Paging Alex K (primary).

Alex K: saw the page, joining. quick status: spikes started ~00:18 UTC, p95->1200ms, p99 ~2.4s. customer impact: higher latency for streaming sessions, a few timeouts.

Priya N: i'm on secondary, can take post-handoff if you need to rest. Are we sure it's serving runtime or infra?

Alex K: initial look points to increased GC and long tails on a subset of dedicated nodes. stack traces show repeated full gc cycles on host pool-dedicated-3.

Jorge R: checking node metrics. I see Lyra-rt instances with memory pressure and high swap. CPU mostly fine. Possible regression from recent runtime tweak last night (kernel selection change).

Maria S: tagging runbook excerpt:/runbooks/serving/high-latency.md -> follow steps 1-3 (drain, rollback, notify).

Alex K: doing a soft drain of pool-dedicated-3: `redwoodctl pool drain pool-dedicated-3 --grace 30s` (running).

oncall-bot: Drain initiated by Alex K. Estimated drain complete ~00:27 UTC.

Priya N: while draining, how's routing? traffic should shift to pooled hosts and dedicated-high. Are we auto-failing over?

Jorge R: routing rules in control plane show fallback to model-variant v1-quantized when capacity low, but for this pool the autoscaler didn't trigger enough nodes. opening a quick scaling override: `redwoodctl scale pool-dedicated-3 --replicas 4`

Alex K: scaling requested. also rolling back runtime kernel change on a canary host to confirm: `kubectl -n serving set env ds/rt-canary KERNEL_MODE=stable`

Maria S: added note in thread: customers with streaming sessions may see reconnects. we should message support with a short triage note.

Lina T: I'll file a ticket for customer outreach and impacted accounts list. Filing now.

Lina T: ticket created TCK-6421: "Prod latency — us-west-2 — possible runtime regression". Assigned to eng-runtime, priority P1. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TCK-6421

Alex K: drain completed, p99 dropped to ~700ms and trending down. Rolling back change confirmed as likely culprit — canary host after rollback p99 back to baseline.

Jorge R: autoscaler now added replicas, no swap observed on new nodes. routing stabilized.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0412-7 severity lowered to pg (mitigated) by Alex K.

Alex K: handing off to Priya for overnight coverage. Summary: root cause suspected runtime kernel selection change deployed 00:05 UTC to canary -> propagated; caused GC pressure on dedicated pool-dedicated-3. Mitigation: drained pool, scaled up replicas, rolled back kernel env on canary. Metrics stable.

Priya N: taking primary for next 8h. Received handoff. My contact: priya@redwood.ai. I'll monitor until 08:30 UTC and schedule follow-ups. Anything I should watch specifically?

Alex K: watch p99, heap growth on pool-dedicated-* hosts, and the rollback patch on canary. Runbook pointers: 1) Serving -> High latency (steps 1–4) 2) Autoscaler troubleshooting (links in #eng-infra pinned). Also note TCK-6421 for customer comms and ENGRT-813 for runtime revert.

Priya N: acknowledged. I'll create a short post-handoff checklist in the ticket and add a retention dashboard.

Lina T: follow-up items I added to TCK-6421: action items: (a) eng-runtime to revert kernel selector PR (owner: Jorge R, due: 2026-04-13), (b) add canary guardrails to deploy flow (owner: Maria S, due: 2026-04-20), (c) customer comms draft (owner: Lina T, due: 2026-04-12).

Maria S: scheduling a retrospective meeting: 2026-04-15 16:00 UTC. Invite sent to eng-runtime, eng-sre, product ops. Agenda: timeline, deploy gating, autoscaler thresholds, alerts tuning.

Priya N: quick note — coverage gap from 02:00–03:00 UTC next Tue due to on-call rotation overlap. I'll coordinate with Alex to ensure backup.

Alex K: I can extend overlap by 30m if needed. flagging in calendar.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded. Primary: Priya N (until 08:30 UTC). Secondary: Alex K. Incident thread linked to TCK-6421 and INC-2026-0412-7.

Priya N: post-handoff follow-ups I'll do in morning: 1) confirm runtime revert PR status 2) validate autoscaler thresholds and create a synthetic test for p99 regression 3) validate customer outreach list from Lina.

Lina T: added comments to ticket with affected customers list and suggested support blurb.

Jorge R: I'll start the runtime revert PR now and add a safety toggle to disable kernel selection by model. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/rt/pull/813-revert

Alex K: thanks team. If anything spikes, ping me and I can jump back in. :thumbsup:

Priya N: thanks all, standing by. :coffee:
